## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

In mathematics, statistics discrete and continuous are two types of quantitative variable. The same is also in computer programming. It is meant to accommode these differences.


In R there is not much difference, it is
Here it is the discrete.


This type of object is to store number as defined in the discrete value, countable thing.

The most natural type of box is used to store integer.
They are essentially the set of natural number.

This is used when certain type of variable in statistics or to encode difference equation.

Memory usage too!

Could use continuous called numeric see @sec-sec-quantitativeCoding

R will force to be numeric

## Formal {.unnumbered}
this is with L in R

## Examples {.unnumbered}
```{r}
#| echo: true

a <- 2L
cc <- 2

# The function str here assess the type of the object
str(a)
str(cc)

str(a + a)
str(a + cc)
```
